title: Finite scalar extension of total tensor complexes
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $X$ be any scheme. Let $R$ be the completed coefficient sheaf, $R_n$ the finite coefficient sheaf at exponent $n+1$, and $F_n$ the actual termwise ordinary scalar-extension functor along $R\to R_n$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. For any two unbounded complexes $P,Q$ of $R$-module sheaves, there is an isomorphism $\beta:F_n(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R Q))\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Tot}(F_n(P)\otimes_{R_n}F_n(Q))$, with the actual signed total tensors [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Write $\gamma_n(M;a,x)$ for the recorded sheafified reduction generator. On a total-degree summand $p+q=k$, for every object $V$ of the opposite site and sections $a\in R_n(V)$, $x\in P^p(V)$, $y\in Q^q(V)$, its component satisfies $\beta^k(\gamma_n(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R Q)^k;a,\iota_{p,q}(x\otimes y)))=\iota_{p,q}(\gamma_n(P^p;a,x)\otimes\gamma_n(Q^q;1,y))$. The inclusions and sheafified pure tensors are those of the specified model. No flatness or completeness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Identify the recorded scalar-extension functor with the sheafified sectionwise tensor functor by a natural isomorphism, using both the specified object equalities and map equations of reductionWitness. The scalar tensor comparison sends a tensor (x tensor y) to (a tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). Its inverse multiplies the two finite scalars; balancing and sheafification prove the inverse identities and naturality.

proof.text: Scalar extension is left adjoint to restriction and preserves the coproducts in the total complex. Apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison to the module tensor comparison; the comparison is an isomorphism on every summand and hence degreewise. Its summand-inclusion formula, the reduction-generator naturality equation, and scalar linearity give the displayed formula. Naturality commutes with the two signed differential summands.

lean.statement:
theorem integralFiniteTensorComparison (P Q : Cx l E X none) (n : ℕ) :
    let F := (reduction l E X none n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let S := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t}
      (topology X none) (ring l E X none)).obj (P, Q)
    ∃ β : F.obj S ≅
        (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t + 1, t} (topology X none)
          (finite l E X none n)).obj (F.obj P, F.obj Q),
      ∀ (p q k : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = k) (V : (Site X none)ᵒᵖ)
          (a : (finite l E X none n).obj.obj V)
          (x : (P.X p).val.obj V) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj V),
        (β.hom.f k).val.app V
            (generator l E X none n (S.X k) V a
              (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t} (topology X none)
                (ring l E X none) P Q p q k hpq V x y)) =
          coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t} (topology X none)
            (finite l E X none n) (F.obj P) (F.obj Q) p q k hpq V
            (generator l E X none n (P.X p) V a x)
            (generator l E X none n (Q.X q) V 1 y)
